- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. ## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8d31c8d8d401d4e9b66f15d618d22f17dab46a84`
Local-runs: probe — one JSON-parse comparison of the six base/head ledger blobs (`git show` output) to read leaf keys, statuses, evidence, proof, verifiedAt and tracker numbers structurally instead of by eye over 77 long strings; no repo code, build, test or gate ran.

Read: card #20234 (body and all 46 comments, among them the pointer `5858331362`, the claim `5903336242`, the dev report `5903777612`, the seat's ruling 1 `5903816491`, the stage-10 ACCEPT `5902947213` and landing `5903202064`, and the stage-2 record `5861396181` for the bar), ruling C+D `5749154545` on #19123, PR #20772 (body, 4-file list, 1 commit, `git diff origin/main...8d31c8d8d4`, merge base `a51920f5fb`, base `f284ab26dd` an ancestor of `origin/main` `c9c182ed14`), the ten anchor commits (subject, message, stat; changeset or diff where a note claims more than the subject), AGENTS.md lines 12–18 and 428–456 at `origin/main`, `packages/spec/package.json` files[], `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` (the one reader that shows a `note` to an author), REST `issues/N` without redirects over 48 numbers with lit and dead controls, and the check-runs on the head, read last.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Accept set and public surface — nothing moves, and that is right.** The diff is three `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` ledgers and one changeset: no `.zod.ts`, no export, no generated page, no migration entry. The ledgers are published data (`files[]` of `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 names `liveness`), which is the only reason a changeset exists (②).

**(b) Structural read — PASS.** Base and head parse; leaf counts are equal per file (manifest 182, dataset 77, permission 150); 0 keys added, 0 removed; 77 leaves changed (38 + 18 + 21), every one a `note` or the manifest `_note`; 0 `status`, `evidence`, `proof` or `verifiedAt` leaf differs. Tracker numbers: 0 added in any file (per changed note the head's number set is a subset of the base's); removed: 11 numbers in manifest, 1 in dataset, 4 in permission, 14 distinct, on 64 + 36 + 34 = 134 base occurrences — the dev's 134 sites over 14 numbers. REST `issues/N` without redirects at 04:1xZ: all 14 answer 404 (#10627 #10724 #10726 #10729 #10812 #10934 #10959 #11210 #11328 #11330 #11331 #11332 #11333 #13003); the 32 distinct numbers the three head files still carry all answer 200, 0 answer 301; controls #20234 = 200, #8710 = 404. So the three files carry no dead site at head, and every number left — `PR #11209` and `PR #11327` among them, kept as links beside a sha — is live. Status of the rewritten rows: manifest 22 live, 14 dead, 1 live-elsewhere plus the `_note`; dataset 18 live; permission 21 live; none `experimental`, none `authorWarn`, so the one reader that surfaces a `note` to an author (`lint-liveness-properties.ts:159` and `:390`) surfaces none of these. The notes are agent-read anchors, form C's territory: the claim's scope answer is right.

**(c) The ten anchor commits — PASS.** Every 9-hex sha resolves to one commit and is an ancestor of `origin/main`; each commit's own content decides what the note now says.
- `9ee2dcfbd` for #13003 (79 sites: 22 manifest, 36 dataset, 21 permission): subject "(#13003 batch 2) (#13038)", body "Part of #13003", its changeset names these ledgers; the `RE-ANCHORED (#13003)` phrase counts parent 0 → 22 / 18 / 21 at that commit, equal to main today, and `git log -S '#13003'` on each file returns it alone. Right. The 18 dataset clauses "the #13003 ACCEPT ruling sorts as OLDEST" → "the review accepting that re-anchoring sorts as OLDEST" (form D): the clause first appears in `9ee2dcfbd` itself; batch 1 (`93ea19bca`, 64 minutes earlier) carries no such rule; the scripts sort stale rows oldest-first and bucket undated ones separately (`check-liveness.mts:1838`, liveness README:166), so the OLDEST rule lived only in a ruling on the deleted card. Which batch's review issued it the tree cannot show; "that re-anchoring" reads as this commit's own, one word more specific than the tree supports. True in substance (an accepting review on the #13003 card sorted undated rows as OLDEST); wording, under ③.
- `be21955ba` for #10627 (14), #10724 (13) and the four #10812 form-D sites: body "#10627 measured exactly ONE non-test read of manifest.contributes monorepo-wide (engine.ts, member kinds), controlled and re-verified on current main at claim time (objectstack main@ac59744: engine.ts:4604-4606 only; ... cloud: delivered clean reading 2026-08-24 @5b5925a)", "cloud census leg discharged clean 2026-08-24", nine retired-key entries plus the D3 entry `plugin-manifest-contributes-dead-members-retired`, ledger rows updated; dated 2026-08-25. So "the census recorded in commit be21955ba", "that census's verdict table", "re-verified for line drift on 2026-08-25 when the retirement in commit be21955ba was claimed" (engine.ts:4604-4606 in the note and in the commit), "EXECUTED in commit be21955ba", the nine "(commit be21955ba, ADR-0049)" rows, "the census verdict that commit records", and "the 2026-08-24 reading (recorded in commit be21955ba, discharging that retirement's precondition)" each say what the commit says. Right.
- `0b048393f` for the functions row: a one-file change to `docs/adr/0088-metadata-kind-admission-and-retirement.md`, subject "correct ADR-0088's 'function' delivered-form row — contributes.functions was never a delivered form (#10724)"; ADR-0088:41 on main carries "Correction (#10724, 2026-08-25)". "that row was wrong, and commit 0b048393f corrected it" (tense moved from "is wrong … its correction rides #10724") is what the tree shows. Right.
- `bc56e1881` for #10726 (2) and the #11328 form-D site: subject "retire `contributes.routes` (ruled Option B) and redirect its last two teaching sites to the `http.server` mount"; changeset headline "(#10726, ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; maintainer-ruled Option B 2026-08-22)"; dated 2026-08-26; its second squashed message names `plugin-rest-api.zod.ts`'s worked manifest example and `metadata-plugin.zod.ts`'s `router` delivered-form comments, and its stat touches both files. "EXECUTED 2026-08-26 in commit bc56e1881 (maintainer-ruled Option B 2026-08-22, …)" and "the two remaining teaching sites (…) were redirected in the removal PR itself" are true with the "#11328:" prefix gone. Right.
- `dce5cd4f0` for #11332 (3): subject names the three containers (capabilities, configuration, extensions); changeset headline "(#11332, ADR-0049)". Right for all three rows.
- `a9ee98992` for #11330 (1): subject "manifest.runtime trust-tier text states publish-gate-only enforcement truthfully", changeset "(#11330)", its test file "Maintainer ruling 2026-08-30 (verbatim 「同意」), option B: say it truthfully", body "which is why the key is not retired"; dated 2026-08-30. "Maintainer ruling 2026-08-30 (executed by commit a9ee98992) took option B — correct the text, do not retire the key". Right.
- `3fc606687` for #10729 (1): the seeding commit (manifest.json created, 300 lines) whose text carries "filed as #10729" once, and `git log -S 'filed as #10729'` returns it alone, so "CAVEAT ON THE LIVE VERDICT, recorded at this row's seeding (commit 3fc606687)" is exact. The other commit naming #10729, `10485009a6`, changes the `registerApp` kind log line in engine.ts and says nothing of `getAllKinds`'s zero callers; not citing it is right.
- `de6e2bfcb` for #10959 (7): subject "adopt the adjudicated proof→ledger bindings, and correct the stale systemPermissions note (#11209)"; body "Executes the spec seat's adjudication on PR #10934", the three bindings (crud-persona-matrix → all four `permission.objects.allow*` verbs, fls-read-mask-strip → `fields.readable`, sharing-rule-org-less-caller → `systemPermissions`, "whose ledger note turned out STALE on re-verification, so it is corrected here"); dated 2026-08-23; `git log -S '#10959'` on permission.json returns it as the writer. "Proof-bound 2026-08-23 (commit de6e2bfcb …)" five times, "Re-verified 2026-08-23 (commit de6e2bfcb) and the note CORRECTED", and "(commit de6e2bfcb, PR #11209)" — the PR in its own subject, live, a link beside the sha in ruling C's allowed form. Right.
- `976b687ab` for #10934 (2): subject "(#10934)"; body "three have a fitting ledger entry and are proposed for binding in the PR body (adoption is a ledger edit and therefore a review decision)". "adopting the adjudicated proposal of commit 976b687ab": the proposal's text sat in the PR body that now answers 404, but the commit's own message records that it was made and `de6e2bfcb`'s records that it was adjudicated and executed; the commit is the in-repo object that carried it. Right.
- `905019b1b` for #11210 (4): body "Part of #11210", "permission.tabPermissions cited hono-plugin.ts:1200 in a 717-line file with zero `tabPermissions` occurrences. All THREE of its pointers were dead — one past EOF, and resolve-execution-context.ts:205 / rest-server.ts:1551 within bounds with zero occurrences each. Repointed … verifiedAt stamped", and it adds `checkCitationLines`; its permission.json diff is the tabPermissions row (`git log -S 'Re-verified 2026-08-23 (#11210)'` returns it alone). "Re-verified 2026-08-23 (commit 905019b1b)", "the rot commit 905019b1b's line bound now makes impossible to leave behind silently", and allowExport's "the line bound (commit 905019b1b)" twice are what the commit did. Right.
- #11331 (2), form D: "tracked on #11331" → "and still unbuilt"; "the #11331 resolution / review chain" → "whatever builds that load-time re-verification". Tree: `verifyIntegrity`'s only non-test caller is `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/publish.ts:128`, the publish preflight; no loader or unpack re-verification exists, and `f89812e4db` (2026-09-08) attributes it to the future runtime loader. The sentence says what the tree shows and no more — the row's own preceding clause already says "zero implementation in this repo". Right.
- #11333 (1), form D: "the structured arm's zero is filed as #11333" → "is recorded apart". Tree: it is recorded apart — `manifest.zod.ts`'s `PluginPermissionsSchema` docblock on main ("Registered is not enforced. Nothing queries that registry … REFUSES NOTHING today … measured and recorded in commit aaacf1d5c"), written by `aaacf1d5c5` (2026-09-12), whose message names #11333 ("Phase 1b of #11333"; maintainer option B on the permissions half, 2026-09-12). True on main today, so the sentence passes the form-D test; but form C was available (that commit, or that docblock), and the dev's premise "no in-repo record states the card's disposition of that sentence" is contradicted by `aaacf1d5c5`'s message. Not false; under ③.

**(d) Text someone acts on.** Changeset: "Notes in these three ledgers named GitHub issues that no longer exist" — true, 14 × 404. "Each such note now names the commit that made the decision and, where the number alone carried the meaning, says what was decided" — read as either/or it holds; read literally it is over-broad by one note, `manifest` `props.integrity.note`, whose only dead number (#11331) went form D and which names no commit. "The `liveness/` ledgers ship in this package's tarball" — true (`files[]`). "Note text only: no row's status, evidence, proof or date changes, and no schema, export or runtime behaviour changes" — true, (a) and (b). `Clause-②: no` — true, (a). PR body: "cite the commit that decided each note" — the same one-note over-breadth; "Only `note` and `_note` strings change: no row's status, evidence, proof or date moves" — true; "One `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset, because `liveness/` ships in the package" — true. Commit message: "134 note sites across three ledgers cited GitHub issues that answer 404" — true; "Note strings only: every row's status, evidence, proof and verifiedAt is unchanged" — true. Every one of these is true on `main` the moment this PR lands; none waits on another PR. The rewritten notes are the AI-facing text and are judged in (c). The liveness README (29 dead sites, 9 of them these 14 numbers) quotes none of the changed phrasings (eight distinctive removed phrasings grepped at head: 0 hits), and the three script comments that cite #13003 (`check-liveness.test.ts:221-224`, `evidence.test.ts:359-363`, `scripts/check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors.mjs:29`) are comments outside this stage's fence, as the claim says.

### ② Semver level

`patch` is right and `Clause-②: no` is right. The bytes ship (`liveness` is in `files[]`), so `skip-changeset` would be wrong; nothing exported, typed, keyed or accepted moves (①b), so nothing above `patch` is warranted; `9ee2dcfbd` itself, and stages 1, 2 and 10 of this card, took `patch` for the same act. The changeset frontmatter names the one package, `'@objectstack/spec': patch`; Check Changeset and Lint & Repo Gates (which carry `check-empty-changeset` and `check-changeset-no-major`) are success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags
Blocking: none.
Dev deviations (`5903777612`): (1) attribution — the commit ends with the model-free trailer pair AGENTS.md line 453 prescribes and carries no model identifier, and the PR body ends with the session-URL footer AGENTS.md prescribes for PR bodies; right, and the harness-requested trailer was correctly not used. (2) the temporary ESLint probe file — not in the diff (4 files) and not in the commit; nothing to judge. (3) labels — none written by the dev; the PR carries `documentation`, `size/m`, `tooling` (the labelers) and `needs:contract-review` (the seat's ruling 1); right. (4) branch history — exactly one commit on `origin/main..8d31c8d8d4`, base `f284ab26dd` an ancestor of `origin/main`, `mergeable: true`, `mergeable_state: clean`; right. (5) worktree removal — outside the diff.
Open question (how to stage the remaining 271 ledger sites and the README's 29): answered A by the seat's ruling 1 (`5903816491`), a staging call the seat owns; this review concurs that whole-file stages keep each PR's structural proof per file. Not re-measured here: the remaining files are untouched by this diff.
Out-of-scope findings, each with its carrier: (1) the next stages → #20234; right. (2) `CITATION_RE` skipping the second number of a `#A/#B` pair and a `#N-era` spelling → #20636, the gate's spelling closeout card, the disposition stage 10 gave `re-charter #N`; right. (3) `check:platform-checklist` exit 1 on base and head (`identity-auth.json`'s `twoFactor` anchor) → not per-PR CI, the daily watchdog; no changed file feeds it, and Lint & Repo Gates is success here; right. (4) dead numbers outside `packages/spec`, and `kernel/manifest.test.ts:437` → #20556 and a later stage; right, the claim forbids `packages/spec/src`.
Non-blocking wording: (a) dataset, 18 clauses: "the review accepting that re-anchoring" names batch 2's review where the tree shows only an accepting review on the #13003 card that predates or accompanies `9ee2dcfbd`; substance unchanged, the row is dated 2026-08-28 since that commit. (b) manifest `permissions`: "recorded apart" is form D where form C existed (`aaacf1d5c5`, the `PluginPermissionsSchema` docblock); the README stage or a rider may add the pointer. (c) changeset, PR body and commit message: "each note names the commit" is one note over-broad (integrity). (d) the dev report's "as stage 1 wrote the same leg" for #11331: neither "still unbuilt" nor "whatever builds that load-time" occurs in `packages/spec/src` at main, so the consistency claim is unverified; the sentence's truth does not depend on it.
